item.title: 《影之刃零》首日 Steam 在线峰值超 66 万，登上全球热销榜首
item.guid: 《影之刃零》首日-Steam-在线峰值超-66-万，登上全球热销榜首
item.description:
The dark martial arts action game "Phantom Blade Zero," developed by S-GAME, was officially released on October 29th. SteamDB records visible that evening showed its peak concurrent players on Steam reached 661,931, ranking first on the global bestseller list. 灵游坊开发的暗黑武侠动作游戏《影之刃零》于 10 月 29 日正式发售。SteamDB 在当晚可见的记录显示，其 Steam 同时在线峰值已达到 661931 人，并位列全球热销榜第一。

The Steam store shows that the game is independently developed and published by S-GAME, using the Unreal Engine 5. Players take on the role of a swordsman with a damaged heart and only 66 days left to live, seeking the truth while being hunted in the martial arts world; combat includes over thirty main weapons and more than twenty bizarre armaments, combining traditional martial arts, mechanical prosthetics, and industrial ruins in a "Kung Fu Punk" style. Steam 商店显示，游戏由 S-GAME 自主研发和发行，采用虚幻 5 引擎。玩家扮演心脏受创、仅剩 66 天生命的剑客，在武林追杀中寻找真相；战斗包含三十余种主武器和二十多门奇诡武装，结合传统武侠、机械义肢和工业遗迹的「功夫朋克」风格。

As of the evening of October 29, Steam Store's simplified Chinese reviews are "Mostly Positive," with 5,166 simplified Chinese reviews displayed on the page; Metacritic's average media score shown in the store is 88 points. The standard edition in the Chinese region costs 268 yuan, and the digital deluxe edition costs 328 yuan. 截至 10 月 29 日晚，Steam 商店简体中文评测为「多半好评」，页面显示 5166 条简中评价；商店展示的 Metacritic 媒体均分为 88 分。国区标准版售价 268 元，数字豪华版 328 元。

item.title: 苹果高管回应 iPad mini 仍是 60Hz
item.guid: 苹果高管回应-iPad-mini-仍是-60Hz
item.description:
According to 9to5Mac, Apple's VP of Hardware Engineering, Dave Pakula, recently gave an interview to YouTube channels Christopher Lawley and Katarina Mogus, discussing the new iPad mini's screen, acoustic design, and product positioning. 据 9to5Mac 报道，苹果硬件工程副总裁戴夫 · 帕库拉（Dave Pakula）日前接受了 YouTube 频道 Christopher Lawley 和 Katarina Mogus 的采访，谈到了新款 iPad mini 的屏幕、声学设计和产品定位。

Regarding the public's concern about the 60Hz refresh rate, Pakula stated that the display experience does not depend on a single parameter. OLED's pixel response time is more than an order of magnitude faster than LCD, which allows for smoother visuals and significantly reduces motion blur. Coupled with contrast, brightness, and color performance, he believes it is an excellent display. 针对外界关注的 60Hz 刷新率问题，帕库拉表示，显示体验不取决于单一参数。OLED 的像素响应时间比 LCD 快一个数量级以上，能让画面更流畅，并显著减少动态模糊。再加上对比度、亮度和色彩表现，他认为这是一块出色的显示屏。

When discussing the positioning of the iPad mini alongside the iPhone Duo, Pakula stated that the iPad mini offers "a complete iPad experience in your palm," with access to over a million apps in the App Store, support for Apple Pencil Pro, and iPadOS 27's multitasking features. 在谈到 iPad mini 与 iPhone Duo 并存时的定位，帕库拉称，iPad mini 是「掌中的完整 iPad 体验」，可使用 App Store 中超过百万款应用，支持 Apple Pencil Pro，并搭载 iPadOS 27 的多任务功能。

item.title: 王传福披露比亚迪员工突破 102 万，研发工程师达 12 万
item.guid: 王传福披露比亚迪员工突破-102-万，研发工程师达-12-万
item.description:
Wang Chuanfu, Chairman and President of BYD, revealed at the 33rd China Society of Automotive Engineers Annual Conference held on October 28 that BYD's total number of employees has exceeded 1.02 million, including 960,000 domestically and 60,000 overseas. The company has 120,000 R&D engineers, covering fields such as batteries, motors, electronic controls, and semiconductors. 比亚迪董事长兼总裁王传福在 10 月 28 日举行的第三十三届中国汽车工程学会年会上透露，比亚迪员工总数已突破 102 万人，其中国内 96 万人、海外 6 万人，研发工程师达到 12 万名，覆盖电池、电机、电控和半导体等领域。

Wang Chuanfu received the 2026 China Society of Automotive Engineers Science and Technology Award - Rao Bin Award for the Automotive Industry at the conference. In his acceptance speech, he recalled that BYD, founded in 1994 and entering the automotive industry in 2003, has consistently adopted a highly vertically integrated model, continuously mastering core technologies for new energy vehicles. 王传福在会上获得 2026 年度中国汽车工程学会科学技术奖汽车工业饶斌奖。他在获奖感言中回顾，比亚迪从 1994 年创业、2003 年进入汽车工业，一直采取高度垂直整合模式，持续掌握新能源汽车核心技术。

According to Beijing News, the award citation mentioned that BYD's sales increased from approximately 400,000 units to 4.6 million units in five years, with products entering over 120 countries and regions. Wang Chuanfu stated that he hopes BYD's development will "prove that China's new energy vehicles can succeed, and China's automotive industry can succeed." 据新京报报道，现场颁奖词提到，比亚迪五年间销量从约 40 万辆增至 460 万辆，产品进入 120 多个国家和地区。王传福表示，希望通过比亚迪的发展「证明中国新能源可以，中国汽车可以」。

item.title: Omdia：三季度全球手机出货量降 20%，苹果持平、小米降 29%
item.guid: Omdia：三季度全球手机出货量降-20%，苹果持平、小米降-29%
item.description:
Omdia's latest full Q3 data states that global smartphone shipments in Q3 2026 were 254.7 million units, a year-on-year decrease of 20%, marking a new low for the third quarter since 2013. The agency believes that continuous price increases are suppressing replacement demand, and channels are also cautiously stocking due to rising equipment costs and capital tie-ups. Omdia 最新公布的完整三季度数据称，2026 年第三季度全球智能手机出货量为 2.547 亿部，同比下降 20%，创 2013 年以来第三季度新低。机构认为，持续涨价抑制换机需求，渠道也因设备成本和资金占用上升而谨慎备货。

Samsung maintained its lead with 57.8 million units, a 5% year-on-year decrease; Apple's shipments were 56.5 million units, flat compared to the same period last year. Omdia noted that continued sales of the iPhone 17, along with channels stocking up in anticipation of price increases, supported Apple's demand in the Chinese and North American markets. 三星以 5780 万部保持第一，同比下降 5%；苹果出货量为 5650 万部，与去年同期持平。Omdia 指出，iPhone 17 持续销售，以及渠道在预期涨价前提前备货，支撑了苹果在中国和北美市场的需求。

Xiaomi's shipments were 30.7 million units, a 29% year-on-year decrease; OPPO (including realme and OnePlus) had 23.4 million units, down 39%; vivo had 19.3 million units, down 33%. The African market saw a 39% decline, and declines in the Asia-Pacific region (excluding Greater China), the Middle East, and Latin America all exceeded 20%. 小米出货量为 3070 万部，同比下降 29%；OPPO（含 realme 和一加）为 2340 万部，下降 39%；vivo 为 1930 万部，下降 33%。非洲市场降幅达到 39%，亚太地区（不含大中华区）、中东和拉丁美洲的降幅也均超过 20%。

Omdia expects global smartphone shipments to decline by 12% in 2026 and continue to decline in 2027, but with a narrower decrease. Limited storage supply, rising prices, and limited promotional space will continue to affect inventory decisions for manufacturers and channels. Omdia 预计，2026 年全球智能手机出货量将下降 12%，2027 年仍将下滑，但降幅收窄。存储供应受限、价格上涨及有限的促销空间，将继续影响厂商和渠道的库存决策。

item.title: OpenAI 宣布 ChatGPT Pro 全系额度翻倍
item.guid: OpenAI-宣布-ChatGPT-Pro-全系额度翻倍
item.description:
Just now, Tibo, OpenAI's Head of Product, announced that starting today, the usage limits for ChatGPT Pro 100, Pro 200, Pro 500 tiers, and Business Premium will be doubled. Existing subscriptions will automatically take effect without the need for application. 刚刚，OpenAI 产品负责人 Tibo 宣布，即日起将 ChatGPT Pro 100、Pro 200、Pro 500 三个层级以及 Business Premium 的使用限额翻倍，现有订阅无需申请，自动生效。

Tibo also stated that OpenAI will not reduce the usage limit for Pro 200, users' Work and Codex usage will remain unchanged, extended limits for dots will continue to be provided, and dot usage will still be calculated separately from default usage. Tibo 同时表示，OpenAI 不会降低 Pro 200 的使用限额，用户的 Work 和 Codex 使用量保持不变，dots 的扩展限额也将继续提供，dot 使用量仍与默认使用量分开计算。

Official help documentation shows that the Work and Codex quotas for Pro 100 and Pro 500 have been doubled, and the weekly message limit for using GPT-6 Pro in the ChatGPT chat interface remains unchanged. 官方帮助文档显示，Pro 100 和 Pro 500 的 Work 和 Codex 额度提高至此前两倍，在 ChatGPT 聊天界面使用 GPT-6 Pro 的每周消息上限不变。

Users of Pro 200 who previously had lower quotas have had them doubled, while users with higher quotas remain unchanged, ultimately unifying to the same level. The Pro 200 quota reduction plan notified via email on September 29 has been officially canceled. Pro 200 此前额度较低的用户获得翻倍，原本额度较高的用户保持不变，最终统一至同一水平。9 月 29 日邮件通知的 Pro 200 额度削减计划已正式取消。

The usage limits for ChatGPT Plus remain unchanged, and some Plus users expressed dissatisfaction in Tibo's comment section. ChatGPT Plus 的使用额度保持不变，部分 Plus 用户在 Tibo 的评论区表达不满。

Related reading: Just now, ChatGPT officially announced a doubling of quotas, but free resets might be gone 相关阅读： 刚刚，ChatGPT 额度官宣翻倍，但免费重置可能要没了

item.title: 美国计算机专业入学人数再降，本科两年减少 18.4%
item.guid: 美国计算机专业入学人数再降，本科两年减少-18.4%
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, preliminary fall data released by the National Student Clearinghouse on October 29 indicates that undergraduate enrollment in computer and information science majors at U.S. colleges and universities decreased by over 12% year-on-year, and graduate enrollment decreased by over 10%. This continues the decline that began last year, reversing the multi-year growth trend in computer science majors. 据彭博社报道，美国国家学生信息交换中心 10 月 29 日发布的秋季初步数据表明，美国高校计算机与信息科学专业本科入学人数同比下降超过 12%，研究生入学人数下降超过 10%。这延续了去年开始的下滑，计算机专业此前多年的增长趋势已发生逆转。

Calculated by cumulative change over two years, the number of undergraduate students in related majors decreased by 18.4%, and graduate students by 27.1%. Matthew Holsapple, head of research at the institution, stated that this is a significant decrease for a major that was, not long ago, one of the fastest-growing fields in higher education. 以两年累计变化计算，相关专业本科生人数减少 18.4%，研究生减少 27.1%。该机构研究负责人 Matthew Holsapple 表示，这对于一个不久前仍是高等教育增长最快领域之一的专业而言，是显著的降幅。

During the same period, overall undergraduate enrollment in U.S. universities increased by 0.6%, while graduate enrollment decreased by 1.6%. The report links the employment pressure faced by computer science majors to companies reducing entry-level programming positions and the rise of AI capabilities. 同期，美国高校整体本科入学人数增长 0.6%，研究生人数下降 1.6%。报道将计算机专业面临的就业压力与企业减少初级编程岗位、AI 能力上升联系起来。

This preliminary statistic does not yet include international student enrollment, and the full report is expected to be released in January 2027. 这份初步统计尚未纳入国际学生入学情况，完整报告预计于 2027 年 1 月公布。

item.title: 上半年中国 MaaS 市场达 106.3 亿元，火山引擎以 45.1% 的份额位居第一
item.guid: 上半年中国-MaaS-市场达-106.3-亿元，火山引擎以-45.1%-的份额位居第一
item.description:
Volcano Engine cited the IDC "China AI Software Market Semiannual Tracker, 26H1" report on October 29, stating that in the first half of 2026, China's MaaS (Model as a Service) market reached 10.63 billion RMB, with Volcano Engine ranking first with a 45.1% share. The article specifies that the statistics target large model public cloud services provided by cloud vendors to external customers, excluding calls from proprietary businesses such as Doubao and Jimeng. 火山引擎 10 月 29 日援引 IDC《中国 AI 软件市场半年度追踪，26H1》报告称，2026 年上半年中国 MaaS（模型即服务）市场规模达到 106.3 亿元人民币，火山引擎以 45.1% 的份额位居第一。文中列明，统计针对云厂商向外部客户提供的大模型公有云服务，不包含豆包、即梦等自有业务调用。

MaaS's share in China's public cloud PaaS market has risen to 21.0%. By revenue composition, large language models account for 47.0% of the MaaS market, video generation models contribute 32.7%, and other modality models account for 20.2%. MaaS 在中国公有云 PaaS 市场中的占比已升至 21.0%。按收入构成，大语言模型占 MaaS 市场的 47.0%，视频生成模型贡献 32.7%，其他模态模型占 20.2%。

In addition to model invocation, Volcano Engine is also expanding its intelligent agent hosting services. The company states that Managed Agents have generated nearly 5 million task sessions within two months of launch, with thousands of enterprises using them for tasks such as digital employees and marketing; this service provides agent runtime capabilities through a unified Agent API, eliminating the need for enterprises to build their own corresponding infrastructure. 除模型调用外，火山引擎还在拓展智能体托管服务。公司称，Managed Agents 上线两个月已产生近 500 万个任务会话，数千家企业将其用于数字员工、营销等任务；这项服务通过统一的 Agent API 提供智能体运行能力，企业无需自行搭建相应基础设施。

item.title: 豆包工作向企业开放第三方模型，可统一调用 Kimi、GLM 与 DeepSeek
item.guid: 豆包工作向企业开放第三方模型，可统一调用-Kimi、GLM-与-DeepSeek
item.description:
Doubao Work announced the opening of third-party large model services to enterprise customers, with the first batch integrating models such as Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, allowing enterprises to choose models from different vendors to handle tasks within the same work environment. 豆包工作宣布向企业客户开放第三方大模型服务，首批接入 Kimi K3.1 Pro、GLM 5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 等模型，企业可在同一工作环境中选择不同厂商的模型处理任务。

This update is for team subscription and enterprise subscription customers. The feature will be enabled by default upon launch, requiring no additional purchase from model vendors or extra application. Usage will be deducted from the enterprise's existing AI points. 本次更新面向团队订阅版和企业订阅版客户，功能上线后默认开启，无需另向模型厂商采购或额外申请，使用量从企业已有的 AI 点数中扣除。

Administrators can define the scope of availability by member, department, group, or all employees. They can enable models in bulk by vendor or configure a specific model individually. Enterprises can also specify where models take effect, such as on Doubao PC, Doubao Work PC, mobile, web, and Doubao Work within Feishu, for example, only open on work PCs and Feishu Workstation. 管理员可按成员、部门、群组或全员划定可用范围，既能按厂商批量启用，也能单独配置某个模型。企业还可指定模型在豆包电脑端、豆包工作电脑端、移动端、网页端和飞书内豆包工作等场景生效，例如只在工作电脑与飞书工作台开放。

item.title: 韩国拟将 AI 眼镜作弊禁考期延至 3 年，考场将配专人识别
item.guid: 韩国拟将-AI-眼镜作弊禁考期延至-3-年，考场将配专人识别
item.description:
The South Korean Ministry of Education announced countermeasures against smart glasses cheating in exams on October 29. It plans to pursue criminal charges against those who intentionally interfere with national exams using smart glasses through reporting and requesting investigations, and to push for extending the ban period for college entrance exam cheaters from the current one year (the following year) to three years. 韩国教育部 10 月 29 日公布智能眼镜考试作弊应对方案，计划通过举报、申请调查等方式，对利用智能眼镜蓄意干扰国家考试的行为追究刑事责任，并推动将高考作弊者的禁考期从现行的次年 1 年延长至 3 年。

Current regulations distinguish different situations: using or wearing smart glasses during an exam results in the invalidation of that exam's score and disqualification from applying the following year; merely carrying or possessing smart glasses results in the invalidation of that exam's score; refusing inspection by invigilators leads to a review to decide whether to invalidate the score and disqualify from the following year. The plan to extend the ban to three years requires amending the "Higher Education Act". 现行规定区分了不同情形：在考试中使用或佩戴智能眼镜，当次成绩作废，并取消次年报考资格；仅携带、持有智能眼镜，当次成绩作废；拒绝监考人员检查，则经审议决定是否作废成绩并取消次年资格。延长至 3 年的方案需要修改《高等教育法》。

Starting from this college entrance exam, each test center will designate one smart glasses identification specialist, who will contact local education departments and the Ministry of Education's emergency center for review if necessary. The Ministry of Education will also evaluate the availability of radio detectors in exam rooms and study their deployment next year; concurrently, it will expand the coverage and claim period of invigilator liability insurance. 从本次高考起，每个考点将指定 1 名智能眼镜识别专员，必要时联络地方教育厅和教育部应急中心复核。教育部还将评估考场无线电探测器的可用性，研究明年部署；同时扩大监考人员责任险的保障范围与索赔期限。

item.title: 中汽学会发布 2027 年技术趋势：400Wh/kg 固态电池将进入中试
item.guid: 中汽学会发布-2027-年技术趋势：400Wh/kg-固态电池将进入中试
item.description:
According to Yicai, the Society of Automotive Engineers of China released the "Top Ten Automotive Technology Trends for 2027" at its annual conference on October 28, covering areas such as solid-state batteries, automotive chips, chassis control, vehicle-to-grid interaction, and edge models. 据第一财经报道，中国汽车工程学会在 10 月 28 日年会上发布《2027 年度中国汽车十大技术趋势》，涵盖固态电池、汽车芯片、底盘控制、车网互动和端侧模型等方向。

Zheng Yali, Deputy Secretary-General of the Society of Automotive Engineers of China and Executive Dean of the National Automotive Strategy Institute, stated that the report divides predictions into three categories: technological performance and cost breakthroughs, mass production adoption of new technologies, and expansion of application scale. Several key directions include: 中国汽车工程学会副秘书长、国汽战略院执行院长郑亚莉表示，报告将预测分为技术性能与成本突破、新技术量产搭载、应用规模扩大三类。几个重点方向包括：

    Solid-state batteries: 400Wh/kg-class battery cells are expected to enter pilot production, with leading enterprises taking the lead in vehicle engineering verification, focusing on overcoming challenges such as solid-solid interfaces, lithium dendrite suppression, and dry electrodes.

    Chassis control: Integrated vehicle motion control technology that uniformly coordinates drive, braking, steering, and suspension will penetrate from flagship models to more vehicle types and price segments.

    Vehicle-road-cloud collaboration: Connected assisted driving is expected to move from demonstration and verification to small-batch pre-installation. Zheng Yali stated that by 2026, 22 car manufacturers had already conducted R&D verification in 8 cities.

Other directions also include high-safety automotive MCUs, V2G, integrated magnesium alloy forming, autonomous truck platooning, distributed in-wheel drive, cockpit edge models, and metal 3D printing. 其余方向还包括高安全等级汽车 MCU、V2G、镁合金一体化成形、自动驾驶卡车编队、分布式轮毂驱动、座舱端侧模型和金属 3D 打印。

item.title: 小米拟出资 17 亿元入股欣旺达动力，增资后持股 5.34%
item.guid: 小米拟出资-17-亿元入股欣旺达动力，增资后持股-5.34%
item.description:
Sunwoda disclosed that Hanxing Venture Capital, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Xiaomi Technology, intends to invest 1.7 billion RMB to subscribe for new shares in Sunwoda EVB, holding 5.34% after the transaction. The relevant capital increase agreement has been signed, and the matter has been approved by the board of directors, still requiring submission to the shareholders' meeting for deliberation. 欣旺达披露，小米科技全资子公司瀚星创业投资拟出资 17 亿元，认购欣旺达动力新增股份，交易完成后持股 5.34%。相关增资协议已经签署，事项经董事会审议通过，尚需提交股东会审议。

Upon completion of this capital increase and board reshuffle, Sunwoda's stake in Sunwoda EVB held through Huizhou New Energy will decrease from 24.06% to 22.78%. With board seats not exceeding half, Sunwoda EVB will transition from a controlled subsidiary to an associate company and will no longer be included in Sunwoda's consolidated financial statements. 本次增资及董事会换届完成后，欣旺达通过惠州新能源持有的欣旺达动力股份将由 24.06% 降至 22.78%，董事会席位不超过半数，欣旺达动力将由控股子公司转为参股公司，不再纳入欣旺达合并报表。

The announced equity table shows that Li Auto is also among the shareholders, with a shareholding ratio of 8.32% after this capital increase. Before Xiaomi's investment, Li Auto had already reached a strategic cooperation agreement on power batteries with Sunwoda Electric Vehicle Battery and CALB in September this year. 公告股权表显示，理想汽车也在股东之列，本次增资后的持股比例为 8.32%。小米入股前，今年 9 月已与欣旺达动力、中创新航达成动力电池战略合作。

item.title: 比亚迪三季度归母净利润增 28%，前三季度仍同比下降
item.guid: 比亚迪三季度归母净利润增-28%，前三季度仍同比下降
item.description:
BYD released its Q3 2026 report, with single-quarter operating revenue of 221.488 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 13.59%; net profit attributable to parent company of 10.020 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 28.08%; and non-GAAP net profit attributable to parent company of 8.630 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 25.25%. 比亚迪发布 2026 年第三季度报告，单季营业收入 2214.88 亿元，同比增长 13.59%；归母净利润 100.20 亿元，同比增长 28.08%；扣非归母净利润 86.30 亿元，同比增长 25.25%。

Cumulative operating revenue for the first three quarters was 566.304 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 0.01%; net profit attributable to parent company was 22.345 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 4.24%; and non-GAAP net profit attributable to parent company was 21.004 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 2.51%. Net cash flow from operating activities was 54.470 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 33.36%, which the company explained was mainly due to a decrease in cash paid for goods purchased and services received. 前三季度累计营业收入为 5663.04 亿元，同比增长 0.01%；归母净利润 223.45 亿元，同比下降 4.24%；扣非归母净利润 210.04 亿元，同比增长 2.51%。经营活动现金流净额为 544.70 亿元，同比增长 33.36%，公司解释主要与购买商品、接受劳务支付的现金减少有关。

The report also shows that inventories at the end of the period increased by 60.08% compared to the end of the previous year, mainly due to the growth of overseas automotive business and increased stocking; financial expenses increased, mainly due to exchange losses incurred in the current period, whereas the same period last year saw exchange gains. This quarterly financial report is unaudited. 报告同时显示，期末存货较上年末增加 60.08%，主要因海外汽车业务增长、备货增加；财务费用增加，主要因本期出现汇兑损失，而去年同期为汇兑收益。该季度财务报告未经审计。

item.title: DoorDash 拟以 170 亿美元收购 Instacart，保留独立品牌和 App
item.guid: DoorDash-拟以-170-亿美元收购-Instacart，保留独立品牌和-App
item.description:
According to TechCrunch, DoorDash announced on October 29 that it has agreed to acquire grocery delivery platform Instacart for $17 billion, corresponding to a total value of $65 per share. Both boards of directors have approved the transaction, which is expected to close by the end of 2027 or the first half of 2028. 据 TechCrunch 报道，DoorDash 于 10 月 29 日宣布，已同意以 170 亿美元收购生鲜配送平台 Instacart，对应每股总价值 65 美元。双方董事会均已批准交易，预计于 2027 年底或 2028 年上半年完成。

DoorDash plans to retain Instacart's brand, enterprise technology products, and app. The two companies will continue to operate independently until the transaction closes. Instacart CEO Chris Rogers stated that the company's grocery technology for retailers, retail, and brand partnerships will be combined with DoorDash's global consumer network and logistics capabilities. DoorDash 计划保留 Instacart 的品牌、企业技术产品和 App。交易完成前，两家公司继续独立运营。Instacart CEO Chris Rogers 表示，公司面向零售商的生鲜技术、零售及品牌合作关系，将与 DoorDash 的全球消费者网络和物流能力结合。

DoorDash stated that Instacart's technology can help more supermarkets build their own online ordering platforms and advertising businesses, and supermarkets can also use DoorDash's fulfillment services to process online orders. DoorDash CEO Xu Xun said that Instacart's experience in grocery selection and substitute options is complementary to DoorDash's delivery network and local merchant tools. DoorDash 称，Instacart 的技术可帮助更多商超搭建自有线上订购平台与广告业务，商超也可使用 DoorDash 的履约服务处理线上订单。DoorDash CEO 徐迅表示，Instacart 在生鲜挑选和替代品选择方面的经验，与 DoorDash 配送网络及本地商户工具具有互补性。

item.title: 英特尔数据中心收入增 78%，预计 PC 疲软延续至明年上半年
item.guid: 英特尔数据中心收入增-78%，预计-PC-疲软延续至明年上半年
item.description:
Intel announced its Q3 2026 results, with revenue of $16.5 billion, a year-on-year increase of 21%; GAAP net profit attributable to parent company of approximately $3.3 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 18%, and adjusted net profit of approximately $2.8 billion, a year-on-year increase of 169%. GAAP diluted earnings per share were $0.60, and adjusted earnings per share were $0.52. 英特尔公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，营收为 165 亿美元，同比增长 21%；GAAP 归母净利润约 33 亿美元，同比下降 18%，经调整净利润约 28 亿美元，同比增长 169%。GAAP 摊薄每股收益为 0.60 美元，经调整每股收益为 0.52 美元。

Business performance showed divergence: Client Computing and Physical AI division revenue was $8.1 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 5%; Data Center and AI division revenue reached $7.3 billion, a year-on-year increase of 78%. CEO Chen Liwu stated that the current top priority is to increase supply to meet the demand for Xeon processors; CFO David Zinsner expects the PC market slowdown to continue at least until the first half of next year. 业务表现出现分化：客户端计算与物理 AI 部门收入为 81 亿美元，同比下降 5%；数据中心与 AI 部门收入达 73 亿美元，同比增长 78%。CEO 陈立武表示，当前首要任务是增加供给，以满足至强处理器的需求；CFO David Zinsner 则预计，PC 市场放缓至少持续到明年上半年。

The company's GAAP gross margin for the quarter was 43%, and operating cash flow was $5.1 billion. Q4 revenue guidance is $15 billion to $16 billion, GAAP earnings per share are expected to be $0.10, and adjusted earnings per share are expected to be $0.25. 公司当季 GAAP 毛利率为 43%，经营现金流为 51 亿美元。第四季度营收指引为 150 亿美元至 160 亿美元，GAAP 每股收益预计为 0.10 美元，经调整每股收益预计为 0.25 美元。

item.title: Reddit 将测试登录后完整访问，应对 AI 抓取与搜索导流下滑
item.guid: Reddit-将测试登录后完整访问，应对-AI-抓取与搜索导流下滑
item.description:
According to TechCrunch, Reddit announced during its Q3 earnings call that it will gradually shift towards a login-centric access experience and plans to test it in some markets outside the US in Q4. 据 TechCrunch 报道，Reddit 在第三季度财报电话会上宣布，将逐步转向以登录用户为主的访问体验，并计划在第四季度先于美国以外的部分市场测试。

Reddit stated that referrals from search engines decreased by an average of over 1 million per week in October. Global daily active users in Q3 were 130.3 million, largely flat quarter-on-quarter; US daily active users decreased from 53.2 million in the previous quarter to 50.7 million, a year-on-year decrease of 2%. Reddit 称，10 月来自搜索引擎的导流平均每周减少超过 100 万次。第三季度全球日活用户为 1.303 亿，环比基本持平；美国日活用户从上季度的 5320 万降至 5070 万，同比下降 2%。

The company hopes to use the login mechanism to protect data, reduce AI scraping, and obtain more user interest and behavior signals for advertising and content recommendations. CEO Steve Huffman stated in a public post that this is the right decision for the platform and business. 公司希望借登录机制保护数据、减少 AI 抓取，并获得更多用户兴趣与行为信号，用于广告及内容推荐。CEO Steve Huffman 在公开帖文中表示，这是对平台与业务的正确决定。

Testing will proceed gradually, and the global rollout time has not yet been determined. Reddit also stated that an unlogged-in homepage is still necessary, and logging in can also retain anonymity, with its anonymous browsing mode being rebuilt. 测试将逐步推进，全球推广时间尚未确定。Reddit 同时表示，未登录首页仍有必要，登录也可保留匿名身份，其匿名浏览模式正在重建。

item.title: 亚马逊 AWS 收入增 39%，过去一年自由现金流净流出 424 亿美元
item.guid: 亚马逊-AWS-收入增-39%，过去一年自由现金流净流出-424-亿美元
item.description:
Amazon released its Q3 2026 financial report, with net sales increasing by 12% year-on-year to $201.9 billion; operating profit rose from $17.4 billion in the same period last year to $28.1 billion, with an operating margin of 13.9%. Net profit was $20.7 billion, lower than $21.2 billion in the same period last year, mainly due to the inclusion of $9.5 billion in pre-tax gains from the Anthropic investment in the prior year. 亚马逊发布 2026 年第三季度财报，净销售额同比增长 12% 至 2019 亿美元；营业利润由上年同期的 174 亿美元升至 281 亿美元，营业利润率达到 13.9%。净利润为 207 亿美元，低于去年同期的 212 亿美元，主要因去年同期计入了来自 Anthropic 投资的 95 亿美元税前收益。

    AWS: Revenue was $46 billion, a year-on-year increase of approximately 39%; operating profit was $17.8 billion, higher than $11.4 billion in the same period last year.

    Retail: North America revenue was $112.9 billion, a year-on-year increase of 6%; international business revenue was $43.1 billion, a year-on-year increase of 5%. The company stated that Prime Day in most major markets was moved to Q2 this year, impacting the year-on-year growth rate for this quarter by approximately 4 percentage points.

    Cash Flow: Operating cash flow for the past 12 months was $168.3 billion, a year-on-year increase of 29%; free cash flow shifted from a net inflow of $14.8 billion in the same period last year to a net outflow of $42.4 billion, mainly due to increased investment in AI-related equipment and infrastructure.

Amazon expects Q4 net sales to be between $240 billion and $247 billion, operating profit to be between $28.5 billion and $33.5 billion, and maintains its full-year cash capital expenditure forecast of approximately $220 billion. 亚马逊预计第四季度净销售额为 2400 亿美元至 2470 亿美元，营业利润为 285 亿美元至 335 亿美元，并维持全年约 2200 亿美元现金资本开支预期。

item.title: 大众前三季度税后亏损 27.2 亿欧元，保时捷商誉减值拖累业绩
item.guid: 大众前三季度税后亏损-27.2-亿欧元，保时捷商誉减值拖累业绩
item.description:
Volkswagen Group announced its Q1-Q3 results on October 29: sales revenue was 233.378 billion euros, a year-on-year decrease of 2.2%; the group reported a post-tax loss of 2.72 billion euros, compared to a profit in the same period last year. Operating profit fell to 71 million euros, with the operating return on sales close to zero. 大众汽车集团 10 月 29 日公布前三季度业绩：销售收入为 2333.78 亿欧元，同比下降 2.2%；集团税后亏损 27.2 亿欧元，去年同期为盈利。经营利润降至 7100 万欧元，经营销售回报率接近零。

Performance was dragged down by 8.7 billion euros in special items, including a 6.4 billion euro impairment of Porsche goodwill and an approximately 1 billion euro impairment of assets of merged companies in China. Excluding special items, operating profit for the first three quarters was 8.8 billion euros, with an operating sales return of 3.8%. 业绩受到 87 亿欧元特殊项目拖累，其中包括 64 亿欧元的保时捷商誉减值，以及约 10 亿欧元中国区合并公司资产减值。剔除特殊项目后，前三季度经营利润为 88 亿欧元，经营销售回报率为 3.8%。

Group CFO and COO Arno Antlitz stated that U.S. tariffs, a shrinking Chinese market, and intensified competition in Europe collectively suppressed profitability; while electric vehicle orders grew, their current profit margins are lower than those of internal combustion engine vehicles, also putting pressure on earnings. Volkswagen's pure electric vehicle orders in Europe increased by 39% year-on-year, with EVs accounting for about 40% of orders in hand in Europe. 集团 CFO 兼 COO Arno Antlitz 表示，美国关税、中国市场收缩与欧洲竞争加剧共同压低盈利；电动车订单增长，但电动车当前利润低于燃油车，也给盈利带来压力。大众欧洲纯电动车订单同比增长 39%，电动车占欧洲在手订单约四成。

Volkswagen expects full-year sales revenue of approximately 315 billion euros in 2026, with an operating sales return of up to about 1%; net cash flow for the automotive business is expected to be between 3 billion and 6 billion euros for the full year. 大众预计 2026 年全年销售收入约 3150 亿欧元，经营销售回报率最高约 1%；汽车业务全年净现金流预期为 30 亿欧元至 60 亿欧元。

item.title: 三星季度营业利润达 107.4 万亿韩元，手机与网络业务仍亏损
item.guid: 三星季度营业利润达-107.4-万亿韩元，手机与网络业务仍亏损
item.description:
Samsung Electronics announced its official third-quarter results on October 29, with consolidated revenue reaching 195.3 trillion Korean won, a 14% increase quarter-on-quarter; operating profit was 107.4 trillion Korean won, setting a new quarterly record. 三星电子 10 月 29 日公布第三季度正式业绩，合并营收达到 195.3 万亿韩元，环比增长 14%；营业利润为 107.4 万亿韩元，再创季度纪录。

The performance of various businesses showed clear differentiation: 各业务的表现分化明显：

    The Semiconductor DS division's revenue was 147.1 trillion Korean won, with an operating profit of 106.5 trillion Korean won. Samsung stated that AI server demand drove up memory prices, and the company expanded sales of HBM4 and server SSDs.

    The combined revenue of the Mobile eXperience (MX) and Network businesses was 37.7 trillion Korean won, but they incurred an operating loss of 600 billion Korean won. New foldable flagships drove revenue growth, but cost pressures continued to drag down year-on-year profit performance.

    Samsung's capital expenditure for the third quarter was 29 trillion Korean won, with full-year capital expenditure expected to be approximately 84.4 trillion Korean won, primarily for new semiconductor plants and infrastructure.

Samsung expects AI infrastructure investment to continue expanding in 2027, and the growth in storage demand driven by AI will exceed industry supply. The company plans to increase the supply of HBM, server DRAM, and SSDs, and establish a more stable sales foundation through multi-year contracts. 三星预计，2027 年 AI 基础设施投资将继续扩大，AI 带来的存储需求增长将超过行业供给。公司计划增加 HBM、服务器 DRAM 与 SSD 供应，并通过多年期合同建立更稳定的销售基础。

item.title: 智元披露上半年营收近 20 亿元，推出机器人「有效智能工时」指标
item.guid: 智元披露上半年营收近-20-亿元，推出机器人「有效智能工时」指标
item.description:
According to a live report from the STAR Market Daily, Zhipu AI disclosed at its Innovation Day conference on October 29 that the company's revenue will approach 2 billion yuan in the first half of 2026. A live report from Yicai Global also confirmed that Zhipu AI's 20,000th embodied intelligent robot rolled off the production line in September this year. 据科创板日报现场报道，智元在 10 月 29 日创新日大会上披露，2026 年上半年公司营收接近 20 亿元。第一财经记者的现场报道同时确认，智元第 2 万台具身智能机器人已于今年 9 月下线。

Peng Zhihui, co-founder, president, and CTO of Zhipu AI, also released Worken (Effective Intelligent Work Hours), which measures the actual output of autonomous robot operations using 'number of active robots × autonomous working hours × output efficiency ratio,' focusing on the results created by robots continuously completing tasks. 智元联合创始人、总裁兼 CTO 彭志辉还发布 Worken（有效智能工时），用「活跃机器人数量 × 自主工作时长 × 产出效能比」衡量机器人自主作业的实际产出，关注机器人持续完成任务创造的成果。

According to a live report from The Paper, this set of metrics has been applied in scenarios such as tourist services at Chengdu Kuanzhai Alley, loading and unloading on Longqi production lines, subway security guidance, Zhuhai Chimelong entertainment performances, Aishida retail guidance, and Shangri-La hotel services. Peng Zhihui believes that physical AI moving from usability to generality requires passing through stages such as usable ontology, deployment in segmented scenarios, generalization of foundation models, swarm intelligence, and intelligent bootstrapping. 据澎湃新闻现场报道，这套指标已用于成都宽窄巷子游客服务、龙旗产线上下料、地铁安检引导、珠海长隆文娱表演、爱仕达零售导购和香格里拉酒店服务等场景。彭志辉认为，物理 AI 从可用走向通用，需要经过可用本体、细分场景部署、基座模型泛化、群体智能和智能自举等阶段。

item.title: 💡 李亮谈红果短剧：核心是内容质量，专家自媒体应遵守道德规范
item.guid: 💡-李亮谈红果短剧：核心是内容质量，专家自媒体应遵守道德规范
item.description:
Yicai Global reported on October 29 that, based on total user usage time, Hongguo has become the fourth largest app in China, trailing only Douyin, WeChat, and Douyin Lite; the article cited QuestMobile data stating that Hongguo's daily active users reached 168 million in July this year. Regarding the development of short dramas and the 'ByteDance time' controversy, Li Liang, Vice President of Douyin Group, published another article on the same day. 第一财经 10 月 29 日报道，按用户总使用时长计算，红果已成为国内第四大 App，仅次于抖音、微信和抖音极速版；该文援引 QuestMobile 数据称，今年 7 月红果日活跃用户达到 1.68 亿。围绕短剧发展与「字节时间」争议，抖音集团副总裁李亮同日再次发文。

Li Liang believes that the main difference between short dramas and traditional film and television dramas lies in their medium and presentation, while the core remains content quality. He gave an example of episode length: if changed to 45 or 90 minutes per episode, the distinction between short dramas, TV series, and movies would narrow. With more knowledgeable and cultured creators joining, he believes the quality of short dramas is rapidly improving. 李亮认为，短剧与传统影视剧的差别主要在载体和表现形式，核心仍是内容质量。他以单集时长为例：若改为 45 分钟或 90 分钟一集，短剧与电视剧、电影之间的区别便会缩小。随着更多有知识、有文化的创作者加入，他认为短剧质量正在迅速提升。

He cited Hongguo's intangible cultural heritage-themed short drama 'Fish Skin Wears New Patterns': the work revolves around the Hezhe ethnic group's fish skin making techniques, telling the story of artisans and young returnees creating fish skin paintings, conducting live broadcasts, and passing on the craft. Li Liang also sees AI as a way to reduce production costs for complex scenes in historical and sci-fi genres, and noted that peers, including Tencent's Green Bubble, are growing rapidly, hoping that all parties 'compete in the sunshine and develop healthily together.' 他举出红果的非遗题材短剧《鱼皮穿出新花样》：作品围绕赫哲族鱼皮制作技艺，讲述手艺人与返乡年轻人制作鱼皮画、开展直播、传承手艺的故事。李亮还看好 AI 在历史、科幻题材中降低复杂场景制作成本，并称包括腾讯绿泡泡在内的同行正在快速增长，希望各方「在阳光下竞争，共同健康发展」。

Regarding the debate with Qin Shuo, Li Liang stated that it is reasonable for experts to transition to self-media and charge higher fees than ordinary self-media, as long as the market accepts it, but they should adhere to basic ethical norms. He opposed using usage duration data from some applications to characterize the entire Chinese internet as 'ByteDance time'. 谈到与秦朔的争论，李亮表示，专家转型自媒体、收费高于普通自媒体，只要市场接受就是合理的，但应遵循基本道德规范。他反对以部分应用的使用时长数据，对整个中国互联网作出「字节时间」的定性。

item.title: 18999 元起，三星 W27 发布：215g 机身支持天通卫星通信
item.guid: 18999-元起，三星-W27-发布：215g-机身支持天通卫星通信
item.description:
Samsung's 'Heart to the World' W27 foldable phone was released on October 29, with pre-orders now open on the official website. The 16GB + 512GB version is priced at 18,999 yuan, and the 16GB + 1TB version is priced at 21,999 yuan, available in 'Jihu Blue' and 'Jixia Red' colors. 三星「心系天下」W27 折叠屏手机 10 月 29 日发布，官网已开放预订。16GB + 512GB 版本售价 18999 元，16GB + 1TB 版本售价 21999 元，提供「霁湖蓝」和「霁霞红」两种配色。

The new phone features a gold frame and hinge decoration, a Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 3 back panel, and a dual-layer titanium shock-absorbing structure at the bottom of the screen. The device weighs approximately 215g, is about 4.1mm thick when unfolded, and about 8.9mm thick when folded (thickness excludes camera module). Key configurations include: 新机采用金色边框与铰链装饰，背板使用康宁大猩猩玻璃陶瓷 3，屏幕底部加入双层钛缓震结构。机身重量约 215g，展开厚约 4.1mm、折叠厚约 8.9mm，厚度不含摄像头模组。主要配置包括：

    Fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 (for Galaxy) processor, paired with 16GB of RAM.

    6.5-inch outer screen and 8.0-inch inner screen, supporting 120Hz adaptive refresh rate and a peak brightness of up to 3000 nits.

    Features a 200-megapixel main camera, a 50-megapixel ultra-wide-angle lens, and a 10-megapixel telephoto lens on the rear, while both internal and external front cameras are 10-megapixel.

    A 5000mAh typical capacity battery, with a 45W charger and a Kevlar magnetic protective case included in the package.

The W27 runs One UI 9, supporting dual-split screen and triple-split screen operations; Tiantong satellite communication can be used for calls and messages, requiring activation of corresponding carrier services first. W27 搭载 One UI 9，支持双分屏和三分屏操作；天通卫星通信可用于通话和短信，需先开通运营商对应业务。

item.title: 王腾发布今日宜休睡眠产品，智能戒指 1799 元起
item.guid: 王腾发布今日宜休睡眠产品，智能戒指-1799-元起
item.description:
On October 29, ISHO (今日宜休), founded by Wang Teng, launched the ISHO Ring smart ring, iFlow smart temperature control system, and the personal sleep health AI technology system ISHO Intelligence. Both hardware products are now available for pre-order. 10 月 29 日，王腾创立的 ISHO 今日宜休发布 ISHO Ring 智能戒指、iFlow 智能温控系统及个人睡眠健康 AI 技术体系 ISHO Intelligence，两款硬件均已开启预售。

    ISHO Ring: Standard Edition 1799 yuan, Pro Edition 2199 yuan, shipping sequentially from November 11. The ring features an inner and outer titanium alloy ring, equipped with an Apollo 330B Plus chip and 32MB storage, capable of offline recording 7 days of data, with a claimed battery life of 6-10 days. The Pro Edition's sensing charging case can also monitor bedroom CO2, temperature, humidity, noise, and light.

    iFlow Smart Temperature Control System: Standard Edition 9999 yuan, Pro Edition starting from 12999 yuan, deliveries begin in December. The system monitors heart rate, respiration, and body movement via dual BCG sensing belts, combined with water circulation and semiconductor temperature control, supporting independent dual-zone temperature adjustment for two people. The Pro Edition adds a 512-point flexible pressure sensing array for sleep posture recognition.

    ISHO App: A personal Agent can interpret sleep reports, integrating sleep, activity, and recovery data into an "Energy Score" from 0-100, providing daily energy management advice; the ring and temperature control system can complement each other in data collection.

At the end of the press conference, Wang Teng thanked Xiaomi and Lei Jun, stating that he cherished his experience at Xiaomi and learned how to make good products and lead a team effectively. 王腾在发布会最后向小米和雷军致谢，称自己珍惜在小米的经历，学会了如何做好产品、带好团队。

In a post-conference interview, he also stated that the company might adopt a two-tiered business model in the future, combining smart hardware and health data services, offering paid subscriptions for some advanced analytical features after accumulating data and expertise. 会后采访中，他还表示，公司未来可能采用智能硬件与健康数据服务两层商业模式，在数据和专业知识积累后，为部分高级分析功能提供付费订阅。

item.title: 小鹏 MONA L05 上市，限时 13.98 万元起
item.guid: 小鹏-MONA-L05-上市，限时-13.98-万元起
item.description:

item.title: 腾讯发布 Buddy One，文档、会议与知识库可跨应用检索
item.guid: 腾讯发布-Buddy-One，文档、会议与知识库可跨应用检索
item.description:
On October 29, Tencent unveiled Buddy One, a cross-application AI collaboration system, at the Global Digital Ecosystem Conference. It integrates Tencent Docs, Tencent Meeting, Tencent Cloud Drive, and ima, sharing the WorkBuddy Agent foundation, accounts, and points pool. Tencent Cloud Drive, released concurrently, provides unified storage for this suite of tools. 10 月 29 日，腾讯在全球数字生态大会发布跨应用 AI 协同体系 Buddy One，打通腾讯文档、腾讯会议、腾讯网盘和 ima，共享 WorkBuddy Agent 底座、账号与积分池。同期发布的腾讯网盘为这套工具提供统一存储。

For individual users, after upgrading the WorkBuddy PC client to version 5.9.0 or higher, various application accounts can be linked in the management center. WorkBuddy can then retrieve authorized documents, meetings, and knowledge bases, integrate information, and cite sources in its answers. Account linking is free and currently does not support unlinking; cross-product memory sharing will be introduced later. 面向个人用户，WorkBuddy PC 端升级至 5.9.0 及以上版本后，可在管理中心关联各应用账号。WorkBuddy 随后能检索已授权的文档、会议与知识库，整合资料并在回答中标明出处。账号关联免费，目前暂不支持解绑；跨产品记忆共享将在后续推出。

After joining Buddy One, WorkBuddy points can be used across linked Tencent Docs, ima, and Tencent Cloud Drive accounts, with the shared balance decreasing synchronously upon consumption. Tencent Meeting currently does not involve point consumption; its linked account can still be used by WorkBuddy to retrieve meeting content. Points previously obtained or purchased separately by users in ima and Tencent Docs will continue to be used according to original rules and will not be merged or cleared. 加入 Buddy One 后，WorkBuddy 积分可在已关联的腾讯文档、ima、腾讯网盘中通用，消耗后共享余额同步减少。腾讯会议目前不涉及积分消耗，其账号关联后仍可供 WorkBuddy 检索会议内容。用户此前在 ima、腾讯文档中单独获得或购买的积分仍按原规则使用，不会合并或清零。

For enterprise users, Tencent announced that WorkBuddy will continue to open its product architecture, supporting self-developed enterprise Agents, third-party Agents, and third-party IM integration. Dowson Tong also previewed the upcoming release of Hunyuan Hy4 and Hy4 flash: Hy4 will strengthen long-range productivity tasks, improve chain-of-thought efficiency, and introduce visual understanding for the first time; Hy4 flash will inherit visual and Agent capabilities. 企业端，腾讯宣布 WorkBuddy 将继续开放产品架构，支持企业自研 Agent、第三方 Agent 及第三方 IM 接入。汤道生还预告混元 Hy4 与 Hy4 flash 近期发布：Hy4 将强化长程生产力任务、提高思维链效率，并首次引入视觉理解；Hy4 flash 则继承视觉与 Agent 能力。

item.title: 699 元，Bose 有线消噪耳塞国行上市
item.guid: 699-元，Bose-有线消噪耳塞国行上市
item.description:
Bose wired noise-cancelling earbuds were launched in China on October 29, with an official price of 699 yuan, available immediately through official channels. The new earbuds feature a USB-C interface, powered by the connected phone, tablet, or computer, eliminating the need for Bluetooth pairing, built-in batteries, or additional charging. Bose 有线消噪耳塞于 10 月 29 日在国内上市，官方售价 699 元，即日起在官方渠道发售。新耳塞采用 USB-C 接口，由连接的手机、平板或电脑供电，不需要蓝牙配对、内置电池或额外充电。

The earbuds feature QuietControl active noise cancellation technology, with two microphones on each side, allowing users to switch between Quiet, Aware, and Off noise cancellation modes via the inline remote. The remote also provides physical buttons for volume, playback, and calls, with a dedicated call microphone on the back. 耳塞搭载 QuietControl 主动消噪技术，每侧配置两枚麦克风，可在线控上切换安静、通透和关闭消噪三种模式。线控还提供音量、播放与通话实体按键，背面设有专用通话麦克风。

The audio section uses SoundDesign digital signal processing technology and UAC2 protocol, fixed to play and output at 24-bit/48kHz specifications. The headphone cable is about 1.28 meters long, the earbuds are IPX4 waterproof, and come with three sizes of silicone ear tips, two sizes of secure ear wings, and a zippered storage case. Color options include classic black, morning mist white, and a limited cool mint color. 音频部分采用 SoundDesign 数字信号处理技术和 UAC2 协议，固定以 24-bit/48kHz 规格播放输出。耳机线长约 1.28 米，耳塞具备 IPX4 防水，随附三种尺寸的硅胶耳塞套、两种尺寸的稳固耳翼和拉链收纳盒。配色包括经典黑、晨雾白，以及限量沁凉薄荷色。

item.title: 尼康发布 120-300mm 长焦镜头，内置 1.4 倍增距镜
item.guid: 尼康发布-120-300mm-长焦镜头，内置-1.4-倍增距镜
item.description:
Nikon released the Nikkor Z 120-300mm f/2.8 TC VR S full-frame telephoto zoom lens on October 29, targeting sports photography. It maintains a constant maximum aperture of f/2.8 in the 120-300mm focal range and has a built-in 1.4x teleconverter, which can extend the focal length to 420mm with a single switch, with the maximum aperture changing to f/4 accordingly. 尼康 10 月 29 日发布尼克尔 Z 120-300mm f/2.8 TC VR S 全画幅长焦变焦镜头，面向体育摄影。它在 120-300mm 焦段保持 f/2.8 恒定最大光圈，并内置 1.4 倍增距镜，一键切换后可覆盖至 420mm，最大光圈相应变为 f/4。

The lens weighs approximately 2735g, about 515g lighter than the F-mount AF-S 120-300mm f/2.8E lens released in 2020. The internal focusing and internal zooming structure keeps the lens barrel length unchanged during focusing and zooming; the Silky Swift VCM motor is responsible for autofocus, combined with meso-porous amorphous coating and ARNEO coating to suppress ghosting and flare. 镜头重约 2735g，比 2020 年推出的 F 卡口 AF-S 120-300mm f/2.8E 镜头轻约 515g。内对焦与内变焦结构让镜身长度在对焦、变焦时保持不变；Silky Swift VCM 马达负责自动对焦，配合中孔非晶态镀膜和 ARNEO 镀膜抑制鬼影与眩光。

When paired with a body that supports synchronized vibration reduction, the lens can achieve up to 6.5 stops of image stabilization at the center and edges of the frame, and supports Arca-Swiss standard quick release plates. Nikon positions it for scenarios requiring rapid switching of shooting distances, such as indoor ice sports, tennis, and football. 搭配支持同步减震的机身时，镜头可在画面中心及边缘实现最高 6.5 挡防抖，并支持阿卡标准云台快装。尼康将其定位于室内冰上赛事、网球、足球等需要快速切换拍摄距离的场景。

item.title: TRAE 宝上线，跨项目记住历史方案并调度开发任务
item.guid: TRAE-宝上线，跨项目记住历史方案并调度开发任务
item.description:
ByteDance's AI development tool TRAE launched its personal assistant "TRAE Bao" on October 29, connecting long-term memory across projects with task execution for individual projects. 字节跳动旗下 AI 开发工具 TRAE 于 10 月 29 日上线个人助理「TRAE 宝」，把跨项目的长期记忆与单个项目的任务执行连接起来。

It adopts a two-layer structure: "Global Assistant + Project Assistant". The Global Assistant can retrieve users' past tasks, conversations, and deliverables, organize historical solutions, constraints, and decisions, and prepare context for new requirements. The official example uses permission management: users can ask it to first find previously implemented solutions, determine which can be reused and which need adjustment, and then hand them over to the Project Assistant for development. 它采用「全局助理 + 项目助理」两层结构。全局助理可查找用户过去的任务、对话和交付产物，整理历史方案、约束与决策，为新需求准备上下文。官方以权限管理为例：用户可以要求它先找出以前做过的方案，判断哪些可复用、哪些需要调整，再交给项目助理开发。

The Project Assistant is responsible for breaking down requirements around the current code and project context, allowing parallel page, interface, testing, and documentation tasks to proceed simultaneously, and organizing joint debugging, verification, and results aggregation by dependency. Developers can also continue to assign other tasks, with the assistant providing centralized feedback on progress, pending items, and deliverables. 项目助理负责围绕当前代码和项目上下文拆解需求，让能够并行的页面、接口、测试和文档任务同时推进，并按依赖组织联调、验证和结果汇总。开发者也可以继续布置其他任务，由助理集中反馈进度、待定事项和交付产物。

item.title: 英伟达开放 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe，支持 40 种语言和长录音转录
item.guid: 英伟达开放-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe，支持-40-种语言和长录音转录
item.description:
NVIDIA has open-sourced its speech model Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and released the multilingual speech data pipeline Granary v2. The model can process recordings up to 1 hour long, supports 40 languages, and can generate verbatim transcripts, organized text, translations, and transcription results with speaker and word-level timestamps based on natural language instructions. 英伟达开放语音模型 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe，并发布多语言语音数据管线 Granary v2。模型可处理最长 1 小时的录音，支持 40 种语言，能按自然语言指令生成逐字稿、整理后的文本、翻译，以及带说话人和词级时间戳的转录结果。

This model uses a mixture-of-experts architecture, with a total of approximately 34 billion parameters including the audio encoder, and about 4.3 billion active parameters. For overlapping speech from multiple speakers, it integrates speaker identification information into speech encoding, supporting speaker diarization from short segments to full meetings and calls. 这款模型采用混合专家架构，含音频编码器在内总参数约 340 亿，激活参数约 43 亿。针对多人重叠说话，它把说话人识别信息融入语音编码，支持从短片段到完整会议、通话的说话人标注。

Official model cards provide BF16, FP8, NVFP4, and other versions, and open weights and fine-tuning tools under the OpenMDW-1.1 license. Granary v2 covers 48 languages and 16 source corpora, generating training materials such as transcriptions, translations, and speech Q&A for approximately 463,000 hours of speech, with the data curation pipeline source code publicly available. 官方模型卡已提供 BF16、FP8、NVFP4 等版本，并采用 OpenMDW-1.1 许可证开放权重和微调工具。Granary v2 则覆盖 48 种语言、16 个源语料库，为约 46.3 万小时语音生成转录、翻译和语音问答等训练材料，数据整理管线源码已公开。

item.title: 智元发布 GO-3 Preview，计划年底开源具身基座模型
item.guid: 智元发布-GO-3-Preview，计划年底开源具身基座模型
item.description:
At the Zhipu Innovation Day on October 29, Yao Maoqing, co-founder, co-president, and president of the embodied intelligence system at Zhipu, released the new generation embodied foundation model GO-3 Preview and announced plans for full open-sourcing by the end of 2026. 在 10 月 29 日的智元创新日上，智元联合创始人、联席总裁、具身智能体系总裁姚卯青发布新一代具身基座模型 GO-3 Preview，并宣布计划于 2026 年底全面开源。

According to Caixin's on-site report, GO-3 Preview adopts Zhipu's self-developed WRAM (World Reasoning Action Model) architecture, which unifies understanding, prediction, and action modeling, targeting cross-task generalization and fine-grained operations. 据财闻现场报道，GO-3 Preview 采用智元自研的 WRAM（World Reasoning Action Model）架构，将理解、预测与动作统一建模，面向跨任务泛化与精细操作。

Centered around this foundation, Zhipu connects the Genie Evolver post-training system with the Genie Master embodied agent framework: the former coordinates real machines, simulations, and world models, while the latter undertakes task execution and feedback after deployment, forming a chain covering pre-training, post-training, and post-deployment learning. Yao Maoqing stated that this system will drive robots to continuously improve their capabilities in real-world operations. 围绕这套基座，智元把 Genie Evolver 后训练系统和 Genie Master 具身智能体框架连接起来：前者协同真机、仿真和世界模型，后者承接部署后的任务执行与反馈，组成覆盖预训练、后训练和部署后学习的链路。姚卯青表示，这套体系将推动机器人在真实作业中持续提升能力。

According to Qiu Xiaofen's on-site report from 36Kr, Zhipu also released the general motion intelligence algorithm framework AGILE, the native multimodal interaction model WITA-OMNI, and the AHA3 third-generation hardware architecture at the same event. WITA-OMNI demonstrated conversations that do not require a wake-up word and can be interrupted; the report cited on-site tests stating that the fastest response was 400 milliseconds, supporting over 20 emotional expressions and 73 languages. 据 36 氪邱晓芬的现场报道，智元同场还发布通用运动智能算法框架 AGILE、原生多模态交互模型 WITA-OMNI，以及 AHA3 第三代硬件架构。WITA-OMNI 在现场展示了无需唤醒词、可被打断的对话；报道援引现场测试称，最快响应为 400 毫秒，支持 20 多种情感表达和 73 种语言。

Lingqu OS 1.0 focuses on the coordination of hardware, communication, and intelligent capabilities, supporting access for over 100 types of peripherals across 15 categories. Zhipu announced its collaboration with the Open Atom Open Source Foundation to jointly build China's humanoid robot open-source community, donating the Lingqu OS project, and plans to fully open-source Lingqu OS 1.0 by the end of 2026. 灵渠 OS 1.0 则面向硬件、通信与智能能力的协同，支持 15 类、100 多种外设接入。智元宣布与开放原子开源基金会共建中国人形机器人开源社区，捐赠灵渠 OS 项目，并计划于 2026 年底将灵渠 OS 1.0 全面开源。

item.title: 一加 Ace 7 系列发布，9000mAh 电池配双路风冷
item.guid: 一加-Ace-7-系列发布，9000mAh-电池配双路风冷
item.description:
OnePlus released the Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro on October 29. Both models feature a 6.78-inch flat screen, a 9000mAh battery, and 100W wired fast charging, and incorporate a dual-channel Glacier Air Cooling system. The screen supports up to 165Hz adaptive refresh rate in daily use, with 185Hz effective in some gaming scenarios. 一加 10 月 29 日发布 Ace 7 和 Ace 7 Pro，两款均采用 6.78 英寸直屏、9000mAh 电池和 100W 有线快充，并加入双路冰河风冷系统。屏幕日常最高支持 165Hz 自适应刷新，185Hz 在部分游戏场景生效。

  • The Ace 7 is equipped with the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Extreme Edition V Series, features a 200-megapixel main camera and an 8-megapixel ultra-wide-angle lens, and offers up to 16GB + 512GB versions. Ace 7 搭载第五代骁龙 8 至尊版 V Series，后置 2 亿像素主摄与 800 万像素超广角，提供最高 16GB + 512GB 版本。
  • The Ace 7 Pro is equipped with the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Extreme Edition, featuring a 200-megapixel main camera in addition to a 50-megapixel periscope telephoto lens that supports 3.5x optical zoom, and offers up to 16GB + 1TB versions. Ace 7 Pro 搭载第五代骁龙 8 至尊版，在 2 亿像素主摄之外配备 5000 万像素潜望长焦，支持 3.5 倍光学变焦，最高提供 16GB + 1TB 版本。

In terms of pricing, the OnePlus Ace 7 starts at 4399 yuan (12GB + 256GB); the Ace 7 Pro starts at 4799 yuan. 价格方面，一加 Ace 7 起售价 4399 元（12GB + 256GB）；Ace 7 Pro 起售价 4799 元。

item.title: Meta 推出 AI 衣橱 App，可从 Instagram 照片搭配穿衣方案
item.guid: Meta-推出-AI-衣橱-App，可从-Instagram-照片搭配穿衣方案
item.description:
According to TechCrunch, Meta has launched its AI fashion app Style Sketch, which is now available on iOS and Android platforms in Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand. 据 TechCrunch 报道，Meta 推出 AI 穿搭应用 Style Sketch，已在印度尼西亚、新加坡和泰国的 iOS 与 Android 平台上线。

The app can connect to Instagram to build a virtual wardrobe from photos users have posted, or users can add clothes by taking photos, short videos, or uploading album pictures. It will suggest outfits based on existing clothes, and users can also specify a single item first to generate different combinations. 应用可连接 Instagram，从用户发布过的照片建立虚拟衣橱，也可通过拍照、短视频或上传相册图片添加衣物。它会基于已有衣物给出搭配，用户也能先指定某件单品，再生成不同组合。

According to the app's description, virtual try-on models can match the user's body shape and skin tone. When traveling, users can input their destination, trip duration, and activity schedule, and the app can even combine this with weather forecasts to generate daily outfit plans. 根据应用介绍，虚拟试穿模特可匹配用户的体型与肤色。出行时，用户输入目的地、行程天数和活动安排，应用还能结合天气预报，生成逐日穿搭计划。

item.title: Mistral 开放 Large 4 权重，编码成绩追平 GLM-5.3
item.guid: Mistral-开放-Large-4-权重，编码成绩追平-GLM-5.3
item.description:
Mistral opened the improved copyright weights for Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) on October 29. This trillion-parameter multimodal model previously entered public preview at the beginning of the month. The new version focuses on enhancing agent encoding, defensive cybersecurity, and inference efficiency, allowing developers to download, deploy, and adjust it themselves. Mistral 于 10 月 29 日开放 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）的改进版权重。这款万亿参数多模态模型此前于月初进入公开预览，新版重点提升智能体编码、防御性网络安全和推理效率，开发者可下载后自行部署和调整。

According to data released by Mistral, the new version achieved a score of 48% on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, close to GLM-5.3, with an average token consumption per task 47% lower than the latter. In Terminal-Bench 4.0, the new version's score increased from 28% in the preview to 41%, with output tokens reduced by 30%. The model offers three inference modes: Low, Medium, and the default High. 据 Mistral 公布的数据，新版在 Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 上取得 48% 的成绩，与 GLM-5.3 接近，每任务平均 Token 消耗比后者少 47%。在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 中，新版得分由预览版的 28% 升至 41%，输出 Token 减少 30%。模型提供 Low、Medium 和默认的 High 三种推理模式。

In the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, which measures vulnerability discovery, verification, and remediation, the model scored 51%. Mistral also provides a preview of specialized secure workflow variants to vetted enterprise design partners, with testing limited to proprietary or explicitly authorized systems. 在用于衡量漏洞发现、验证与修复的 Artificial Analysis Cyber Index 中，模型得分为 51%。Mistral 还向经过审查的企业设计伙伴提供专门的安全工作流变体预览，测试限于自有或明确授权的系统。

The weights are provided via Hugging Face, using the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license, modified from MIT, allowing for use, modification, fine-tuning, and commercialization; enterprises operating Model-as-a-Service must obtain a separate commercial license. Developers can also use the model through the Mistral API, OpenRouter, and Microsoft Foundry. 权重通过 Hugging Face 提供，采用修改自 MIT 的 Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight 许可，可使用、修改、微调和商业化；经营 Model-as-a-Service 服务的企业须另获商业许可。开发者也可通过 Mistral API、OpenRouter 及 Microsoft Foundry 使用模型。

item.title: 《塞尔达传说》40 周年纪念版 Switch 2 发售
item.guid: 《塞尔达传说》40-周年纪念版-Switch-2-发售
item.description:
Nintendo's "The Legend of Zelda" 40th Anniversary Edition Switch 2 was released on October 29, with a Pro Controller and carrying case of the same theme also launched on the same day. The console, Joy-Con 2, and dock feature a special series design, and the Pro Controller comes with a display stand. 任天堂《塞尔达传说》40 周年纪念版 Switch 2 于 10 月 29 日发售，同主题 Pro 手柄和便携包也在当天推出。主机、Joy-Con 2 和底座采用系列特别设计，Pro 手柄附带展示台。

Nintendo specifically noted that the commemorative edition console does not include "The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time" game software. This Switch 2 game is scheduled for release on November 5 and needs to be purchased separately. 任天堂特别注明，纪念版主机不包含《塞尔达传说：时之笛》游戏软件。这款 Switch 2 游戏定于 11 月 5 日发售，需要单独购买。

This batch of hardware is part of the series' 40th-anniversary project. Nintendo has also arranged for the release of Young Link and Young Zelda amiibo in 2027, as well as concerts and museum content themed around the series. 这批硬件是系列 40 周年企划的一部分。任天堂还安排了 2027 年发售的幼年林克、幼年塞尔达 amiibo，以及以系列为主题的音乐会和博物馆内容。

item.title: 吉考斯工业 ×《影之刃零》联名开售，把角色与兵器做成日常服饰
item.guid: 吉考斯工业-×《影之刃零》联名开售，把角色与兵器做成日常服饰
item.description:
With the unlock of "Phantom Blade Zero," the collaboration series between Geek Toys Industrial and the game was launched online on October 29, featuring 10 items that integrate elements of protagonists, bosses, weapons, and scenes into apparel and bags. 随着《影之刃零》解锁，吉考斯工业与游戏的联名系列于 10 月 29 日在线上发售，共推出 10 款单品，将主角、Boss、兵器和场景元素融入服饰与包袋。

In the series, the "Soul" short-sleeved T-shirt uses the smoky imagery of wuxia films to depict the sword-wielding protagonist; the "Jueying" T-shirt combines shoulder armor patterns, knife-cut dark patterns, and distressed wax dyeing; and the "Seven Star Sword Array" long-sleeved T-shirt presents the elder brother's sword array and silk threads through printing and embroidery. 系列中，「魂」短袖 T 恤用武侠电影的烟雾意象表现持剑主角；「绝影」T 恤把肩甲图案、刀割暗纹与做旧蜡染结合；「七星剑阵」长袖 T 恤则通过印花与刺绣呈现大师兄的剑阵和丝线。

Autumn/winter styles include a jacquard sweater cardigan themed after the "Blazing Lion Head" Boss, and a reversible vest inspired by the relationship between "Soul" and "Zuo Shang," which can be switched between a quilted side and a fleece side. The "Weapon Crate" crossbody bag features weapon patterns in its lining, and the shoulder strap is adorned with embroidered "Demon Family Crest" badges from the protagonist's equipment. 秋冬款包括以「烈焰狮头」Boss 为主题的提花毛衣开衫，以及取材于「魂」与「左殇」关系的双面穿马甲，后者可在绗缝面与摇粒绒面之间切换。「武器匣」斜挎包则将兵器图案放入内衬，肩带点缀主角装备上的「魔家纹样」刺绣徽章。

item.title: 继星巴克后，宜家餐厅也重申「消费入座」
item.guid: 继星巴克后，宜家餐厅也重申「消费入座」
item.description:
Following Starbucks, the IKEA restaurant in Xuhui, Shanghai, has also reiterated its "consumption for seating" policy. According to a field visit published by The Paper on October 29, a sign at the restaurant entrance indicates that seats are for dining customers only and asks customers not to occupy seats for long periods, bring their own food, or gather to play cards; during the reporter's visit, elderly individuals who had not made a purchase were stopped at the door. 继星巴克后，上海徐汇宜家餐厅也重申「消费入座」。据澎湃新闻 10 月 29 日发布的现场探访，餐厅入口提示座位仅供就餐顾客使用，并要求顾客不要长时间占座、自带食物或聚众打牌；记者探访时，有未消费的老人被拦在门外。

IKEA's official customer service responded that currently only the Xuhui store is implementing this, and other stores have not yet followed suit. Store staff stated that many elderly people gather on Tuesdays and Thursdays, some bringing their own fruit, drinking alcohol, or playing cards, which has increased the burden of trash cleanup. Elderly people interviewed said that not everyone comes for matchmaking; some are just lonely at home, and some elderly people support the policy of seating after consumption. 宜家官方客服回应，目前仅徐汇店执行，其他门店尚未跟进。门店工作人员称，每周二、周四会有较多老人聚集，有人自带水果、喝酒或打牌，垃圾清理也增加了负担。受访老人则表示，并非所有人都来相亲，有人只是独自在家感到寂寞，也有老人支持消费后入座。

Elderly social gatherings at Xuhui IKEA have a long history. In 2016, the store had already announced a "purchase meal first, then be seated" policy due to issues like prolonged seat occupation and bringing outside food. Starbucks implemented a "consumption for seating" policy nationwide on October 22, promising to prioritize assistance for special groups such as pregnant women and those with mobility issues. 徐汇宜家的老年社交聚会由来已久。门店在 2016 年就曾因长时间占座和自带饮食等问题，宣布「先购餐，后入座」。星巴克已于 10 月 22 日在全国门店实行「消费入座」，并承诺优先帮助孕妇、行动不便者等特殊群体。

item.title: 《危笑 3》换导演，《养鬼吃人》导演大卫·布鲁克纳接手
item.guid: 《危笑-3》换导演，《养鬼吃人》导演大卫·布鲁克纳接手
item.description:
According to an exclusive report by Variety, Paramount has hired new key creatives for "Smile 3": David Bruckner to direct and Nick Antosca to write. Parker Finn, who wrote and directed the first two films, will transition to producer, and the story framework for the third installment will still be proposed by him. 据 Variety 独家报道，派拉蒙已为《危笑 3》聘请新主创：大卫·布鲁克纳执导，尼克·安托斯卡编剧。前两部的编剧兼导演帕克·芬恩将转任制片人，第三部的故事框架仍由他提出。

Bruckner previously directed the 2022 version of "Hellraiser," as well as "The Night House" and "The Ritual." Antosca co-created "The Act" and served as a writer for "Antlers." 布鲁克纳曾执导 2022 年版《养鬼吃人》，以及《夜间小屋》和《黑森灵》。安托斯卡则参与创作了《恶行》，并担任《鹿角》的编剧。

The first two "Smile" films were released in 2022 and 2024, with the story shifting from a psychologist tormented by a sinister smile to a pop singer encountering the same supernatural entity. Finn is currently also directing a remake of "Possession" for Paramount, starring Callum Turner and Margaret Qualley. 《危笑》前两部分别于 2022 年和 2024 年上映，故事从一名被诡异笑容纠缠的心理治疗师，转向遭遇同一超自然实体的流行歌手。芬恩目前还在为派拉蒙执导《着魔》翻拍版，主演为卡勒姆·特纳和玛格丽特·库里。

item.title: 法伦与杰米·李·柯蒂斯恶搞 Theranos 创始人纪录片
item.guid: 法伦与杰米·李·柯蒂斯恶搞-Theranos-创始人纪录片
item.description:
In the opening short film of "The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon," aired on October 28 local time in the U.S., host Jimmy Fallon and Jamie Lee Curtis mimicked Nathan Fielder and Elizabeth Holmes from the documentary "You Can See Everything," reenacting a mutually probing interview. 《吉米今夜秀》在美国当地时间 10 月 28 日播出的开场短片中，主持人吉米·法伦与杰米·李·柯蒂斯模仿纪录片《You Can See Everything》里的内森·菲尔德和伊丽莎白·霍姆斯，重演了一场互相试探的访谈。

Fallon mimicked Fielder's tone, repeatedly pressing the guest on whether they genuinely wanted to be on the show; Curtis, wearing a blonde wig and lowering her voice, played Holmes, emphasizing that she was genuinely communicating with the host. As soon as Fallon left, she immediately changed her demeanor, becoming the punchline of the entire short film. 法伦模仿菲尔德的语气，反复追问嘉宾是否真心想来上节目；柯蒂斯戴上金色假发、压低嗓音扮演霍姆斯，强调自己是在与主持人真诚交流。等法伦离开，她立即换了态度，成为整段短片的笑点。

The original documentary, co-directed by Alex Gibney and Lance Oppenheim, was secretly filmed for over three years, documenting the life of Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes one month before she began serving her sentence for defrauding investors, and was released in the US on October 16. Curtis's appearance on the show was to promote her co-created and guest-starring NBC new comedy "Newlyweds". 原纪录片由菲尔德与兰斯·奥本海姆联合执导，历时三年多秘密拍摄，记录 Theranos 创始人霍姆斯因欺诈投资者开始服刑前一个月的生活，已于 10 月 16 日在美国上映。柯蒂斯此次登上节目，是为她参与联合创作并客串的 NBC 新喜剧《Newlyweds》宣传。

item.title: 索尼取得《缄默祸运》电影改编权，库萨马执导
item.guid: 索尼取得《缄默祸运》电影改编权，库萨马执导
item.description:
According to Deadline, Sony Pictures has acquired the film adaptation rights for the psychological horror game "Mouthwashing", to be directed by Karyn Kusama, known for "Jennifer's Body" and "The Invitation", with Matt Manfredi and Phil Hay responsible for the screenplay. 据 Deadline 报道，索尼影业取得心理恐怖游戏《缄默祸运》（Mouthwashing）的电影改编权，由《詹妮弗的肉体》《致命邀请》导演卡瑞恩·库萨马执导，马特·曼弗雷迪与菲尔·海负责剧本。

"The Black Phone" director Scott Derrickson, along with C. Robert Cargill and Vince Cheng, will participate in the production through Crooked Highway, a company that has a partnership agreement with Sony's Screen Gems. 《黑色电话》导演斯科特·德瑞克森与 C. Robert Cargill、Vince Cheng 将通过 Crooked Highway 参与制片，该公司与索尼旗下 Screen Gems 有合作协议。

The original work, developed by Swedish independent studio Wrong Organ and published by Critical Reflex, was released in 2024. It revolves around five crew members trapped on the cargo spaceship Tulpar, presenting character relationships under resource shortages, isolation, and suspicion through non-linear storytelling. Kusama and the two screenwriters previously collaborated on "The Invitation" and "Aeon Flux". 原作由瑞典独立工作室 Wrong Organ 开发、Critical Reflex 发行，于 2024 年推出，围绕困在货运飞船 Tulpar 上的五名船员展开，以非线性叙事呈现物资短缺、隔离和猜疑下的人物关系。库萨马与两位编剧此前曾合作《致命邀请》和《无间炼狱》。
